Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep an eye on the sustained strength in AI leaders like Nvidia and Microsoft, and closely monitor your leveraged positions for further decay or sharp moves.

Bottom line:
Manage your leveraged losers aggressively while staying alert to opportunities in core tech/AI names.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its SELL status, deep -26.91% loss, and leveraged decay.
Watch SPAL closely at its 21.38 stop; its -13.64% loss and leveraged nature demand attention.
Accumulate CRWD near its scanner entry of 272.29-272.02, leveraging its strong momentum and positive AI sentiment.
